compute myPress all pressure myTemp

fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 100.0 iso 0.0 0.0 1000.0

# Run NPT for 10000 steps
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press density lx ly lz pe ke etotal
dump 1 all custom 10000 relaxed_structure.dat id type x y z

run 10000

write_data relaxed_structure.dat"}
